get_runtime_dir: get the runtime directory path by returning sys.path[0] from the detectron environment module
get_py_bin_ext: get the python binary extension string which returns '.py' from the detectron environment module
set_up_matplotlib: set up matplotlib to use the non-interactive Agg backend for headless rendering
exit_on_error: exit the detectron tool with error code 1 when an unrecoverable error occurs
get_detectron_ops_lib: get the path to the detectron ops GPU library by searching standard install prefixes and sys.path
